method: Recorded tool start/end intervals clipped to SDK worker bounds, merged before summing. Historical absent fetch spans are unknown, not zero requests. New fetch spans end on consumer-driven EOF/cancellation/error; they include gateway, transport, generation and client processing/backpressure, not pure network or provider inference. Tool/HTTP overlaps are explicit. Record timestamps and passive observer overhead do not establish exclusive-host causality. Historical diagnosis is post-hoc; original outcomes/costs unchanged.
